findings.title: CronJob misses its starts: startingDeadlineSeconds is too short
findings.cause: CronJob sync's startingDeadlineSeconds is 0, less than the few seconds the controller can take to wake at a scheduled time, so runs it starts late count as missed and are skipped

evidence.what: CronJob sync has startingDeadlineSeconds 0 and schedule "* * * * *"

findings.fix: Raise startingDeadlineSeconds to at least 10, or remove it (no deadline): kubectl patch cronjob sync -n kd-cronjob-misses-starts --type=merge -p '{"spec":{"startingDeadlineSeconds":60}}'.
